candidates.evidence: Two first-order modes at 382.84 and 406.23 cm-1 (separation 23.39 cm-1) match the curated Lee et al. 2010 2H-MoS2 table within 0.1 to 0.3 cm-1 for E2g1 and A1g at 3L (382.8, 405.9). match_library gives MoS2 score 0.9996 with no missing strong modes in 150 to 650 cm-1. Both A1g and E2g are the only first-order MoS2 modes expected in this window.

Computational Raman Database entry crd:98 (mp-1434, R3m, Bagheri and Komsa 2023) is the top matcher hit (E 383.0, A1 406.4 after fitted scale 0.996). The same two modes fit 3R and 2H equally well, and the polytype cannot be separated here because the diagnostic shear and breathing modes lie below the 150 cm-1 cutoff.

Matcher rank 2 (score 0.948, crd:4656, R-3m) only because two modes were fitted with a 0.986 scale. Its A1g is predicted 2.6 cm-1 away from the measured A1 peak (408.8 vs 406.23). It has no curated layered-material reference, so it is rejected as a layered vdW candidate.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given (material_hint null), so this is open identification. The spectrum has two sharp first-order bands at 382.8 and 406.2 cm-1 that match the E2g1/A1g pair of MoS2. The E2g1 to A1g separation of 23.4 cm-1 is the layer-number observable. The 520.5 cm-1 Si line is the substrate. No further bands of MoS2 are detected at the default threshold in 150 to 650 cm-1.

peaks.source: Position and FWHM from window fit 355-435 cm-1 (position err 0.03 cm-1). Assignment: Lee et al. 2010, ACS Nano 4, 2695, doi 10.1021/nn1003937, Fig. 2b (3L 382.8, 2L 383.4, bulk 382.2 at 514.5 nm); CRD crd:98 E mode 383.0 (Bagheri and Komsa 2023, Sci. Data 10, 80).

Position and FWHM from window fit 355-435 cm-1 (position err 0.09 cm-1, FWHM err 0.28 cm-1). Assignment: Lee et al. 2010, ACS Nano 4, 2695, Fig. 2b (3L 405.9, 4L 406.7, bulk 407.4); CRD crd:98 A1 406.4 (Bagheri and Komsa 2023).
Si first-order line of the SiO2/Si substrate. Offset -0.19 cm-1 from the 520.7 cm-1 reference used by rl_qc.py; the MoS2 separation is unaffected by this offset.

properties.name: layers
properties.source: Lee et al. 2010, ACS Nano 4, 2695, Fig. 2b via relation mos2_layer_number_from_separation. Delta = 23.39 cm-1 (fit error about 0.1 cm-1) against 3L 23.1, 4L 24.3, 2L 21.4 cm-1. Only 3L is a candidate within 0.5 cm-1 (moderate confidence). Relation validity 18.1 to 26.2 cm-1, laser 488 to 633 nm, SiO2/Si (532 nm used).

properties.name: phase
properties.source: Lee et al. 2010 curated 2H-MoS2 mode table used for labels. The matcher's top entry is 3R (R3m, crd:98), which predicts the same two modes. The polytype needs the shear or breathing modes below 150 cm-1, outside this window.

citations: Lee, Yan, Brus, Heinz, Hone, Ryu 2010, ACS Nano 4, 2695, doi:10.1021/nn1003937, arXiv:1005.2509, Fig. 2b (E2g1 and A1g positions and their difference vs layer number; read from figure, about +-0.3 cm-1)
Bagheri and Komsa 2023, Sci. Data 10, 80 (Computational Raman Database, CC BY 4.0), entries crd:98 (mp-1434, R3m MoS2), crd:4656 (BrOPr), used via rl.py match_library
limits: Material: MoS2 is well supported by two first-order bands whose positions and E-A1 separation match the MoS2 reference tables. Only two first-order modes lie in the measured 150 to 650 cm-1 window, so the identification rests on a pair rather than a full mode set. No material hint was given, and I did not check the literature figures through the Valency or iopic-bond tools. The curated Lee 2010 table was the only literature reference used.

Polytype: 2H and 3R MoS2 give the same E and A1 pair, and the shear and breathing modes that separate them (about 30 to 40 cm-1) lie below the 150 cm-1 cutoff. The data cannot tell 2H from 3R. The 2H label follows the curated table, not a measured distinction.

Layer number: 3L is the single candidate within 0.5 cm-1, but 4L (24.3 cm-1) is only 0.9 cm-1 from the measured Delta of 23.39. Lee's table was measured at 514.5 nm with 2.7 cm-1 resolution on 285 nm SiO2/Si. The data were taken at 532 nm and 295 K. Strain, doping, laser heating and resolution can shift Delta by about 0.5 to 1 cm-1, so 4L cannot be firmly excluded. The table values were read from a figure at about +-0.3 cm-1. The tool's confidence is moderate.

Calibration: the Si line sits at 520.51 cm-1, 0.19 cm-1 below the 520.7 reference. Absolute MoS2 positions are about 0.2 cm-1 low if the offset applies to the whole spectrum (E about 383.03, A1 about 406.42). The E-A1 separation is unaffected.

Fit method: the full-range 150 to 650 cm-1 fit gave a broader A1 (FWHM 2.9 cm-1) with a residual hump near 400 to 410 cm-1. The window fit 355 to 435 cm-1 resolved the doublet cleanly with white residuals, and its values are reported. The min-snr 2 run did not finish within the time available, so bands weaker than the default detection threshold were not fully checked.

Weak bands: no peak was detected at the default threshold in 420 to 480 cm-1 (2LA(M) region, about 450 cm-1) or in 200 to 250 cm-1 (LA(M) region, about 227 cm-1). Their absence does not exclude MoS2. It also limits any defect or thickness read from second-order and defect bands, which I did not attempt.

Properties not determined: strain and doping (no MoS2 strain or doping relation in the reference notes; the E and A1 positions are within about 0.3 cm-1 of the 3L reference, which is not a quantitative strain or doping result) and defect density (no relation applied).
Polarization: single spectrum, so no polarization classification was made.

Rejected candidates: BrOPr and the other matcher hits (I3InO9, AsO3Sb, Cl6NaNb) fit two modes with 2 to 3 cm-1 errors or missing strong modes, and none is a known layered material with a curated reference. They are not plausible given the MoS2 match.
Temperature: the spectrum is at 295 K. The reference positions in Lee 2010 are room-temperature values, so no temperature correction was applied.
